nodes.text: RNA-seq + Epigenomic Integration (fluentGenomics). Bioc Workflow `fluentGenomics` analog: integrate RNA-seq differential genes with ATAC-seq accessibility regions and ChIP-seq TF binding peaks, link peaks to genes via + .

Microarray Normalization Method Comparison (ExpressionNormalizationWorkflow). Bioc Workflow ExpressionNormalizationWorkflow analog: read raw microarray CEL/IDAT files, normalize with multiple methods (RMA, vsn, lumi, ComBat), compare normalization quality via PCA and variance estimation. For normalization quality comparison and method selection ONLY — NOT for differential expression statistical testing. For differential expression analysis from a normalized microarray count matrix, use nf-core/differentialabundance.

RNA-seq Differential Transcript Usage (rnaseqDTU). Bioc Workflow `rnaseqDTU` analog: quantify transcripts (Salmon), import via tximport, then + DEXSeq + stageR for differential transcript usage with FDR control.
Run a complete rare disease workup — I have WES and RNA-seq

Single-cell Perturb-seq guide barcode calling and assignment to individual cells | guide barcode quantification, UMI thresholding, and assignment to single-cell barcodes for Perturb-seq data → cell-to-guide assignment matrix and QC metrics

Perturbation hit calling and phenotype effect scoring relative to non-targeting controls | statistical hit calling, perturbation strength testing, and differential expression versus non-targeting control cells → perturbation hit summary table and filtered AnnData object

Perturbation state representation learning using scVI and scANVI embedding | deep generative modeling of transcriptional perturbation states using scVI and semi-supervised scANVI embedding → latent space coordinates, perturbation clusters, and batch-corrected embeddings

BioMate: Subworkflow Sprint 3 — Pseudotime + RNA velocity from single-cell data Runs two orthogonal trajectory methods in parallel: — graph-based pseudotime (R / Monocle3) — RNA velocity (Python / scVelo) Both processes accept the same AnnData h5ad input but are. 2-step pipeline: → . Inputs: csv, h5ad. Outputs: anndata, csv, h5ad, png. Key parameters: adata_h5ad, monocle_cluster, root_cell, velocity_mode.

Find tumor-reactive T cells from scRNA-seq data | single-cell RNA-seq transcriptomic and TCR profiling of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes to identify tumor-reactive T cell clonotypes and activation or exhaustion phenotypes → prioritized reactive T cell clusters and TCR sequences

Predict neoantigens from somatic mutations and HLA binding | neoantigen prediction pipeline identifying somatic variants, patient HLA alleles, and predicting mutant peptide-MHC binding affinities and immunogenicity → prioritized candidate neoepitopes

IDAT → Normalisation → Differential Methylation → Gene Enrichment. EPIC/450K array methylation from IDAT — minfi load + functional normalisation, DSS differential methylation, missMethyl gene-set enrichment. Use when you want the DSS-based differential-methylation + enrichment wrapper chain. Also applicable to bismark bisulfite coverage from nf-core/methylseq.
Run RNA-seq analysis and differential expression
predict CYP450 inhibition and hepatic clearance for new chemical entity

Nanostring GeoMx DSP Analysis (GeoMxWorkflows). Bioc Workflow `GeoMxWorkflows` analog: read Nanostring GeoMx DSP NanoStringGeoMxSet, segment-level QC, Q3 normalization, mixed-model linear DE across regions of interest.

Illumina 450k/EPIC Methylation Array DMR Analysis (methylationArrayAnalysis). Bioc Workflow `methylationArrayAnalysis` analog: read IDAT files via minfi, QC, normalize (SWAN or noob), call DMPs (limma), DMRs (DMRcate), gene-set test (missMethyl).
FDA Phase II to Phase III dose justification brief

Public RNA-seq Reanalysis (recountWorkflow). Bioc Workflow `recountWorkflow` analog: pull uniformly-processed counts from recount2/3 for a study (e.g., SRP), scale counts by read length, run DESeq2 DE with technical replicate handling.
RNA-seq differential expression analysis to identify transcriptional signature | bulk RNA-seq quantification and differential gene expression analysis → ranked differential expression gene signature

Find drugs with matching transcriptional signature using LINCS L1000 connectivity mapping | transcriptional signature connectivity matching against perturbational profiles (LINCS L1000/CMap) → ranked candidate drugs and mechanisms of action

Estimate human PK parameters from preclinical animal data (rat, mouse, dog) using interspecies allometric scaling | interspecies allometric scaling of preclinical pharmacokinetic parameters (clearance and volume of distribution from rat, mouse, dog) to project human pharmacokinetics → estimated human CL, Vd, and half-life

Full physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) simulation with organ-specific clearance and special population (renal/hepatic impairment) submodels | whole-body physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) compartmental simulation incorporating organ-specific clearance and special population adjustments (renal and hepatic impairment) → organ and systemic concentration-time profiles

Monte Carlo population sampling to evaluate pharmacokinetic variability and support special population dose adjustments | Monte Carlo population pharmacokinetic simulation sampling physiological, demographic, and clearance parameters across virtual cohorts → exposure variability distributions, confidence intervals, and recommended dose adjustments
Run Voyager spatial ESDA on this Visium dataset

Population pharmacokinetic (PopPK) estimation pipeline with NONMEM primary execution and automatic nlmixr2 (R) fallback when NONMEM is unavailable. BYOL (Bring Your Own License) pattern: -- If NONMEM_HOME and NONMEM_LICENSE_FILE are set → run NONMEM nmfe75/nmfe74 -- Otherwise → fall back to nlmixr2 open-source R implementation Pipeline Steps: 1. -- Validate NONMEM-format dataset structure (ID, TIME, DV, etc.) 2. NONMEM_CTL_GENERATE -- Generate NO
test compound effect over time at 0, 6, 24, and 72 hours
Validate SMILES input file with one SMILES and ID per line | chemical structure validation and standardization from a SMILES table (SMILES and compound ID per line) → validated SMILES dataset

RDKit RECAP decomposition of validated molecules into scaffolds and R-groups | fragmentation of chemical structures using RDKit RECAP cleavage rules into core scaffolds and substituent R-groups → fragmented molecular dataset

mmpdb generation to identify matched molecular pairs and calculate property deltas for fragment swaps | matched molecular pair indexing using mmpdb to evaluate fragment substitutions and compute property deltas → matched molecular pair database and transformation table

Rank novel scaffolds by frequency, drug-likeness, and synthetic accessibility (SA) score | scaffold prioritization based on occurrence frequency, drug-likeness filters, and synthetic accessibility scoring → ranked candidate scaffold summary table

Phase A: Pharmacokinetic exposure profiling and free Cmax simulation across projected therapeutic doses | pharmacokinetic simulation of unbound systemic exposure and free Cmax across target dose levels → free Cmax and exposure metrics for safety margin calculation

Phase B: Cardiovascular core battery simulation (hERG/Ikr inhibition, blood pressure, heart rate, ECG QTc interval) | in silico cardiac electrophysiology and hemodynamic simulation (hERG/Ikr channel blockade, APD90, QTc interval prolongation, mean arterial pressure, heart rate) → cardiovascular safety metrics and arrhythmogenic risk margins

Phase C: Central nervous system (CNS) safety battery simulation (Irwin screen, locomotor activity, neurobehavioral liabilities) | in silico neuropharmacology, BBB partitioning, and neuroreceptor liability screen modeling modified Irwin and Functional Observational Battery (FOB) endpoints → CNS safety scores and behavioral liability margins

Phase D: Respiratory system safety simulation (respiratory rate, tidal volume, minute ventilation) and integrated ICH S7A synthesis | computational respiratory plethysmography simulation (tidal volume, respiratory rate, minute ventilation) combined with integrative ICH S7A safety margin synthesis across CV, CNS, and respiratory domains → integrated safety pharmacology assessment report
Validate gene expression matrix and sample clinical metadata | input validation, sample ID reconciliation, and filtering between a gene expression matrix and clinical metadata table

limma-voom transformation and linear modeling with covariates, empirical Bayes moderation, and topTable extraction | voom precision-weight transformation, linear model fitting with clinical covariates, empirical Bayes moderation, and topTable extraction → logFC and adjusted p-values

GSVA or ssGSEA pathway scoring on MSigDB Hallmark gene sets (50 gene sets) to identify top enriched pathways per group | single-sample pathway enrichment scoring using GSVA or ssGSEA with the 50 MSigDB Hallmark gene sets on normalized expression data → pathway enrichment score matrix and top enriched pathways per phenotype group
